name: Unique Sandwiches
notes: All 3 photos were menu boards. Photo 1 is the full shop menu (espresso/tea drinks, bowls, wraps, deli sandwiches, soup/chili, specialty sandwiches) and was used as the primary source. Photo 2 is a separate breakfast-menu board (B1-B8, served until 10:30am). Photo 3 shows the same Specialty Sandwiches (S1-S9 visible) as photo 1's S1-S9 with identical names/ingredients but older single-item prices instead of photo 1's whole/half pricing; treated as a duplicate/older price list and skipped in favor of photo 1's clearer whole[half] prices. Whole[half] prices for deli/specialty sandwiches are noted in each item's description; only the whole price is given as the numeric price. Choice-of-bread/veggie/condiment lists and extra-cost add-ons (extra meat, bacon, avocado, cheese, etc.) are modifiers and were omitted. W9 Teriyaki Chicken wrap had no legible price and was included without one.
